name: hunt_mx_es_ctrl_pm_first_bar_ema_15

source.title: [Claude hunt 2026-10-20, other markets] CONTROL: the NQ leg cl_pm_first_bar_cdl_ema_15 (13:30 first 15-minute bar followed with the EMA20 side, candle stop) copied unchanged to ES at the hunt's 1:1.5. Why it should pay (the NQ leg's cause): the first bar after lunch shows which side the returning afternoon orders took; with the day's trend the late-day flows (hedging and rebalancing with the day's move) push the same way; S&P futures carry the same afternoon index flows. Who loses: traders who fade the first afternoon push against the day's trend. As a control it asks: is the NQ edge an index-wide afternoon effect (then ES should not lose) or NQ-only (a red flag for the NQ leg)?

entry.words: ES (a copy of the NQ leg): the first 15-minute bar of the afternoon pass (13:30-13:45 ET) closes up and its close is above the 20-bar EMA of 15-minute closes: buy at its close; closes down and below the EMA: sell. Stop at that bar's other extreme, target 1.5 x that distance. Once a day, flat 15:58.
